violations.text: Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils (ice machine) were observed with an accumulation of food and debris. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. Unit taken out of service and cleaned during inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/04/2026

(Pork Ribs) was observed held at (46-53) degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling.PIC voluntarily disposed of product. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/04/2026
Kitchen utensils observed being stored between wall and prep unit. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/04/2026

Rice, which was prepared in advance, was not cooled to 70 degrees Fahrenheit in 2 hours and then to 41 degrees Fahrenheit within 4 hours. Disposed. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 05/08/2025
Mixer paddle for the stand mixer was not in good repair, coating observed peeling. Mixer paddle taken out of service. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 05/08/2025
The dish machine at the bar was not dispensing sanitizer. PIC contacted service; scheduled for later today. New Violation. Correct By: 05/08/2025
